'''The Restless Ghost''' is one of the six [[quests]] released with the launch of ''[[RuneScape Classic]]''. In it, the player helps the [[Father Aereck|priest of the Lumbridge church]] get rid of the ghost that haunts the [[Lumbridge]] graveyard.

==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Father Aereck]] in the chapel south-east of [[Lumbridge Castle]].
|startmap = 3243,3210
|difficulty = Novice
|description = A ghost is haunting [[Lumbridge]] graveyard. The priest of the Lumbridge church of [[Saradomin]] wants you to find out how to get rid of it.
|length = Short
|requirements = Capable of killing or running away from a [[combat level]] 13 [[skeleton]].
|recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|10|link=yes}}
*Fast travel to several locations
**[[Wizard's Tower]] (1 trip) - [[Necklace of passage]] or [[Amulet of the Eye]] or [[Amulet of glory]] to [[Draynor Village]] ''(All members only)''
**[[Father Urhney]] in the [[Lumbridge Swamp]] (1 trip) - [[Necklace of passage]] to [[Wizard's Tower]] or [[Amulet of glory]] to [[Draynor Village]] ''(Both members only)''
**[[Lumbridge]] (3 trips) - [[Lumbridge Teleport]] or [[Lumbridge Home Teleport]] (once)
|kills = [[Skeleton (The Restless Ghost)|Skeleton]] ''(level 13)'' ''(can be avoided)''
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Varlamore}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
{{Map:The Restless Ghost}}
===Ghost speak===
{{Map|3144,3178|3152,3178|3152,3173|3144,3173|mtype=polygon|caption=Father Urhney's small house.|align=right|width=200|height=200|zoom=3}}
[[File:Father Aereck chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Talk to [[Father Aereck]], found in the [[Lumbridge]] chapel just east of [[Bob's Brilliant Axes]]. Tell him you are looking for a quest, and he will ask you to get rid of a [[Restless ghost|ghost]] haunting the graveyard. He suggests you start by talking to [[Father Urhney]], an expert on ghosts.

Go south of the castle, and into the [[Lumbridge Swamp]]. Head west through the swamp until you come upon a small house by the coast and talk to the irate [[Father Urhney]] inside. After you mention [[Father Aereck]]'s request, he gives you an [[amulet of ghostspeak]], which allows you to communicate with the ghost. '''It is highly recommended to keep the amulet for future quests. It is possible to drop the amulet on the ground, and speak to Father Urhney again to obtain duplicate amulets.''' Once you have the amulet in your [[inventory]], teleport or run back to Lumbridge, and make your way to the graveyard located beside the chapel.
{{Clear}}

===Freeing the ghost===
[[File:The Restless Ghost - Battle.png|thumb|250px|Fighting the skeleton in the [[Wizards' Tower]].]]
[[File:Restless ghost chathead.png|left|frameless]]
In a small building in the south-east corner of the graveyard is a [[Coffin (The Restless Ghost)|marble coffin]]. Wearing your [[amulet of ghostspeak]], search the coffin, and a [[Restless ghost|ghost]] will dramatically emerge. Talk to him, and he tells you he is missing his skull. A warlock from the [[Wizards' Tower]] stole it, and he wants it back.
Head to the [[Wizards' Tower]] located on an island south of [[Draynor Village]], and climb down the ladder in the room directly next to the entrance. Across the room, you will find an altar, which you will need to search to obtain the [[ghost's skull]]. '''A [[Skeleton (The Restless Ghost)|skeleton]] will appear and attack you.''' You do not need to fight the skeleton and can simply leave the room. Make sure you have the [[Ghost's skull|skull]] in your inventory.

Run or teleport back to [[Lumbridge]] to speak with the [[restless ghost]]. He wants you to put the skull in his coffin. Use the skull on the coffin, and you will see the ghost's spirit disappear into the river.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Reward==
{{Quest rewards
|name = The Restless Ghost
|image = [[File:The Restless Ghost reward scroll.png|centre]]
|qp = 1
|rewards =
*{{SCP|Prayer|1,125}} [[Prayer]] [[experience]]
*[[Ghostspeak amulet]] (keep for several quests and content in the future)
}}

==Required for completing==
Completion of The Restless Ghost is required for the following:
* [[Animal Magnetism]]
* [[Curse of the Empty Lord]]
* [[Ghosts Ahoy]]
* [[Making History]]
* [[Nature Spirit]]
* [[Creature of Fenkenstrain]]

'''Vampyre Slayer''' is a [[free-to-play]] [[quest]] that takes place in [[Draynor Village]]. The player is asked to slay [[Count Draynor]], a terrifying [[vampyre]] living in a large [[Draynor Manor|mansion]] just to the north of the village, with the help of an experienced vampyre slayer. 

==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Morgan]] in his house in [[Draynor Village]], just north of [[Ned]]'s house.
|startmap = 3098,3268
|difficulty = Intermediate
|description = The people of [[Draynor Village]] live in constant terror. Their numbers are dwindling, all due to the foul creature lurking in the manor to the north known as a vampyre.
|length = Very Short
|requirements = Able to defeat a [[combat level]] 34 [[Count Draynor|vampyre]] with a very high health recovery rate.
|items = *[[Hammer]] (can be bought from the [[general store]] just north of the [[Blue Moon Inn]] for 1 [[coin]])
* [[Beer]] (obtainable during the quest for 2 [[coins]])
* [[Stake]] (obtained during the quest)
|recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|20|link=yes}}
* [[Garlic]], highly recommended to weaken the Count (obtainable during the quest)
*Combat equipment - [[Magic]] is recommended if using the safespot
* Fast travel to [[Varrock]] (such as the [[Varrock teleport]])
* ''(Members only)'' Fast travel to [[Draynor Village]] ([[amulet of glory]] or [[Draynor Manor Teleport]])
|kills = [[Count Draynor]] ''(level 34)'' - safespottable
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Morytania}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
===The vampyre threat===
{{Map|name=Morgan|x=3099|y=3269|r=3|mtype=square|align=right|width=200|height=200|caption=Morgan's location.}}
[[File:Morgan chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Speak to [[Morgan]] in [[Draynor Village]]; his house is just north of [[Ned]]'s. He will ask for your help in putting a stop to the evil [[vampyre]] [[Count Draynor]], residing in his [[Draynor Manor|manor]] to the north.

He wants you to start by talking to the retired vampyre hunter [[Dr Harlow]] for assistance, who frequents the [[Blue Moon Inn]] in [[Varrock]].

If you don't already have [[garlic]], you can search the [[cupboard (Morgan's home)|cupboard]] upstairs to find some.

===The retired vampyre slayer===
[[File:Dr Harlow chathead.png|left|frameless]]
{{Map|name=Dr Harlow|x=3222|y=3397|r=4|mtype=square|align=right|width=200|height=200|caption=Dr Harlow's location at The Blue Moon Inn.}}
The [[Blue Moon Inn]] is located south of the [[Varrock]] central town square. [[Dr Harlow]] will want a drink. Ask for his help dealing with a vampyre, and he will insist that the player give him a beer first.

If you didn't bring one, you may purchase a [[beer]] from the bartender for 2 [[coins]]. 

Talk to him again with the beer and he will give you a [[stake]], which he advises is the easiest way to stop a vampyre from regenerating. He also suggests you use a [[hammer]] to drive the stake in when the vampyre is weak. Finally, he advises that vampyres don't like [[garlic]].

If you don't already have a [[hammer]], you can buy one from the [[Varrock General Store]] to the north for 1 [[coin]].

===Count Draynor===
{{Needed|[[weapon]],  [[armour]], [[food]], [[garlic]], [[hammer]] and a [[stake]]}}
[[File:Count Draynor.png|left|80px|frameless]]
[[File:Count draynor safespot.png|thumb|right|200px|A player fights against Count Draynor using the safespot.]]
Head to [[Draynor Manor]] north of [[Draynor Village]], bringing your combat equipment and [[food]], [[garlic]], a [[hammer]] and the [[stake]]. 

Once inside, go down the large stairs on the east side of the building. There are candles in this room that you can walk on, causing the player to exclaim, but these do not deal damage. There is a [[coffin (Vampyre Slayer)|coffin]] in the centre of the room. Open it and the vampyre, [[Count Draynor]], will pop up and attack you.

If you brought [[garlic]], upon beginning melee combat, the Count will automatically take 10  damage at the start of the fight, and have his attack/strength reduced by 10 levels, and defence by 40. This effect lasts for 30 seconds.

It is possible to [[safespot]] him by running to the south-western corner between the staircase and the skeleton. Once the Count is next to you, step into the tile he is occupying. He should move into the tile you just left, but this may take a couple of tries. Once he is in the corner, move to the square diagonal to him so that you are standing in front of the skeleton. If using the safespot, it is recommended to use [[Magic]] as [[flinching]] with melee is slow and the Count regenerates health at roughly 6 times the rate of regular monsters.

Upon defeating [[Count Draynor]], you will automatically stab him with the hammer and stake; if you didn't bring a hammer, {{Mes|You are unable to push the stake far enough in}} will appear in the chat, and you will be unable to kill him.

'''Note''': It is possible to set up a Dwarf Multi Cannon in this area.

'''Note''': If you take too long to kill Count Draynor, he returns to his coffin and heals to full health.

The quest is completed after defeating the count, and you can exit [[Draynor Manor]] through the exit in the eastern-most room or teleport.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Reward==
{{Quest rewards
|name = Vampyre Slayer
|image = [[File:Vampyre Slayer reward scroll.png|centre]]
|qp = 3
|rewards =
*{{SCP|Attack|4,825}} [[Attack]] [[experience]]

Unlocks:
* [[Count Draynor]] accessible in the [[Nightmare Zone]].
}}

==Required for completing==
Completion of Vampyre Slayer is required for the following:
*[[Sins of the Father]]

'''Witch's Potion''' is a free-to-play quest where players help the witch [[Hetty]] in making a magical potion.

==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Hetty]] in her house in [[Rimmington]], south of [[Falador]] and west of [[Port Sarim]].
|startmap = 2967,3205
|difficulty = Novice
|description = Become one with your darker side. Tap into your hidden depths of magical potential by making a potion with the help of Hetty the Rimmington witch.
|length = Very Short
|items = *[[Burnt meat]]
*[[Eye of newt]]
*[[Onion]]
*[[Rat's tail]] ''(only obtainable after starting the quest)''
|recommended = *Fast travel to [[Rimmington]] to start the quest - [[Teleport to House]] (the default house location is Rimmington) or [[Skills necklace]] to [[Crafting Guild]]
|kills = [[Rat]] ''(level 1)''
|leagueRegion = <poem>
{{LeagueRegion|Asgarnia}} — location requirement
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
===Hetty the witch===
Talk to [[Hetty]] in her house in south-east [[Rimmington]], and tell her you want to know more about the black arts. She will tell you she is making a potion and needs four ingredients that she wants you to get: a [[rat's tail]], a piece of [[Burnt food|burnt meat]], an [[eye of newt]], and an [[onion]].

===Rat's tail===
Kill a level 1 [[rat]] (they can be found in the [[Brian's Archery Supplies|archery shop]] west of [[Hetty]]'s house) to obtain a rat's tail. '''Note: You can only obtain a rat's tail if you have started the quest! Giant rats will NOT drop a rat's tail.'''

===Burnt meat===
'''- You can skip this point if you have already obtained [[Burnt meat]].'''

Kill a [[giant rat]] just north of the chapel graveyard south-east of [[Rimmington]], or kill a [[cow]] in the cow pen just south of Falador, and cook the meat. Meat can be used on the fireplace in Hetty's own house. If you didn't manage to burn the meat, use the [[cooked meat]] on the fire or range to purposely burn it. (A player-lit fire will also work.) You can also buy raw meat from [[Wydin]] at the food store in Port Sarim.

[[File:Witch's Potion - Hetty's Cauldron.png|thumb|right|Hetty's cauldron]]
===Eye of newt===
'''- You can skip this point if you have already obtained an [[Eye of newt]].'''

You can buy an [[eye of newt]] from the [[Betty's Magic Emporium|magic shop]] in [[Port Sarim]] for 3 [[coins]]. The magic shop is labelled with a fire rune symbol on the map.

===Onion===
'''- You can skip this point if you have already obtained an [[onion]].'''

[[Onion]]s can be found in a field directly north of [[Rimmington]] and east of [[Melzar's Maze]], or in the backyard of [[Fred the Farmer]]'s farmhouse west of the sheep pen in [[Lumbridge]].

===Finishing up===
When you have all these items, talk to [[Hetty]]. She'll put them in her cauldron and tell you to drink from it. Drink from the cauldron to complete the quest and gain your reward.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Rewards==
{{Quest rewards
|name = Witch's Potion
|image = [[File:Witch's Potion reward scroll.png|centre]]
|qp = 1
|rewards = 
* {{SCP|Magic|325}} [[Magic]] [[experience]]
}}

}}

==Trivia==
*The quest frequently makes reference to teaching the player dark magic. This is a legacy from ''RuneScape Classic'', as during the first month of its release the quest awarded experience in the skill [[classicrsw:EvilMagic|EvilMagic]].

'''The Knight's Sword''' is a free-to-play intermediate [[Quests|quest]] in which the [[White Knight]] [[Squire Asrol]] needs help making [[Sir Vyvin]] a new ceremonial sword.

==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to the [[squire]] in the courtyard of the [[White Knights' Castle]] in [[Falador]].
|startmap = 2977,3342
|difficulty = Intermediate
|description = Sir Vyvin's squire is in trouble. He has accidentally lost Sir Vyvin's ceremonial sword. Help him find a replacement without Sir Vyvin finding out.
|length = Short
|requirements = * {{SCP|Mining|10|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} {{Questreqstart|no}}
* The ability to run from [[combat level|level]] 57 [[ice warrior]]s and level 53 [[ice giant]]s could help.
|items = * [[Redberry pie]] (not [[half a redberry pie]])
* 2 or 4 [[iron bar]]s (4 if you want your own [[blurite sword]])
*1-3 [[Blurite ore]] (obtained during the quest) - optionally an additional ore each for your own blurite sword and the Falador easy diary ''(Members only)''
* Any [[pickaxe]] (one spawns in Rimmington)
|recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|20|link=yes}}
* [[Armour]] and some [[food]] for aggressive enemies near the [[blurite rocks]]
* Fast travel to several locations:
**[[Falador]] to start the quest plus 2 additional trips - [[Falador Teleport]], [[Ring of wealth]] ''([[Members only]])''
**[[Varrock]] (1 trip) - [[Varrock Teleport]], [[Chronicle]], [[Skills necklace]] to [[Cooks' Guild]] ''([[Members only]])'' or [[Ring of wealth]] to [[Grand Exchange]] ''(Members only)''
**[[Mudskipper Point]] (2 trips) - [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|aiq}} ''(Members only)'', [[Teleport to House]] (Rimmington) ''(Members only)'', [[Rat Pits]] minigame teleport ''(Members only)'', or [[Falador Teleport]]
|ironman = 
*A method to obtain iron bars:
**{{SCP|Mining|15}} [[Mining]] and {{SCP|Smithing|15}} [[Smithing]] if smelting [[iron ore]]
**Spawn in level 18 [[Wilderness]] north-west of the [[Ferox Enclave]], next to the bears west of the Graveyard of Shadows. Accessible via {{SCP|Minigame|Clan Wars}} [[Minigame Teleport]]
**1/42.67 drop from [[dwarf|dwarves]] ({{SCP|Combat|10}}) in the mines under Falador
**''(Members only)'' Spawn in [[Thurid's Brain Buckets]] on the [[Sunset Coast]] in [[Varlamore]] (requires {{SCP|Quest|[[Children of the Sun]]}})
**''(Members only)'' 1/34.42 drop from sorting [[small salvage]] with {{SCP|Sailing|15|link=yes}}
*A method to obtain a redberry pie:
**{{SCP|Cooking|10}} [[Cooking]] to cook one. A pie dish can be found in the [[Varrock Palace]] kitchen, and [[redberries]] can be picked just west of the [[South-east Varrock mine]]
**''(Members only)'' Purchased from [[Romily Weaklax]] in the [[Cooks' Guild]] with {{SCP|Cooking|32|link=yes}} and a [[chef's hat]]
**''(Members only)'' Partial completion of [[Perilous Moons]] to purchase a Redberry pie from [[Yarnio]]
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Not completable, as it requires access to Misthalin.
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
===Sword trouble===
{{Map|name=Squire|x=2977|y=3342|r=3|mtype=square|align=right|caption=The location of Sir Vyvin's squire.|width=200|height=200}}
{{Needed|recommended=Fast travel method to Varrock and Mudskipper Point}}
[[File:Squire chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Talk to the [[Squire]], found in the courtyard of the [[White Knights' Castle]] in [[Falador]]. He has lost [[Sir Vyvin]]'s sword, a family heirloom made many generations ago by the Imcando dwarves. Offer to make a new one and he will mention that [[Reldo]] the [[Varrock Palace]] librarian may know where to find an Imcando dwarf.

:'''Note''': If you have already completed [[The Giant Dwarf]], skip the following step and go straight to [[Thurgo]]; otherwise you must talk to Reldo before you may continue.

Talk to Reldo in the [[Varrock Palace]] library, the northernmost room on the ground floor. Ask him what he knows about Imcando dwarves, and he will point you towards [[Mudskipper Point]], just south of [[Port Sarim]].

:'''Note:''' If you still need ingredients for the [[redberry pie]] required in the following section, you can take the [[pie dish]] from the kitchen to the east now, then pick [[redberries]] by the [[South-east Varrock mine]].
 
{{Map|name=Thurgo|x=3001|y=3144|r=2|mtype=square|align=right|caption=The location of Thurgo, an Imcando dwarf.|width=200|height=200}}

===Thurgo the Imcando dwarf===
{{Needed|[[Redberry pie]]|recommended=Fast travel method to Falador}}
[[File:Thurgo chathead.png|left|frameless|80px]]
Head south of [[Port Sarim]] to find [[Thurgo]] on the west side of a hill, in his hut with the anvil. Ask him if he would like some [[redberry pie]], and he will take some and eat it. Ask if he can make a special sword, and he requests that you bring him a picture of the lost sword as a reference.
{{Clear|left}}
===Acquiring the picture===
[[File:Portrait detail.png|left|100px|frameless]]
Return to the Squire in the Falador Castle courtyard again, and he will mention that a [[portrait]] of Sir Vyvin's father includes the sword.

'''Note:''' You must have spoken to the squire before you may obtain the portrait.

From the courtyard of the [[White Knights' Castle]] in [[Falador]], go east through three doors, and then up the ladder. Go west through the door and then further west through the open doorway, then up the staircase. Sir Vyvin's room will be directly to the south. 

You need to obtain the portrait by searching the [[Cupboard (The Knight's Sword)|cupboard]] inside his room, but Sir Vyvin will stop you if he is inside the room and looking towards the player. Open the door to his room and wait for him to walk out, or hop worlds until you find one where he is outside the room, then take the portrait from the cupboard.

===Mining the blurite===
{{Needed|A [[pickaxe]], the portrait, 2 [[iron bar]]s (4 if making extra sword)|recommended=Food and plate armour (slash resistant) for low levels, fast travel method to Mudskipper Point and Falador|skills={{SCP|Mining|10}} to mine [[blurite ore]]}}
[[File:Asgarnia_Ice_Dungeon_safespot.png|thumb|left|220px|Safespot by the cave entrance sign.]]
[[File:Asgarnian_Ice_Dungeon.png|thumb|right|240px|The Asgarnia Ice Dungeon.]]
Return to [[Thurgo]] and give him the portrait. He now knows a [[blurite sword]] is what he needs to make, and you must obtain the [[blurite ore]] for it. This ore is only found in the [[Asgarnia Ice Dungeon]], located on the hill to the north east. '''All enemies in the dungeon are [[aggressive]], so get ready to run past them'''. Head down the ladder on the hill, run north through the dungeon until you reach the pirates, then head east down the first corridor and enter the large icy room, which contains several bright blue rocks to mine for the ore. At the south-eastern end of the icy room, there is an entrance to the [[skeletal wyvern]]s section of the cave. Standing directly in front of this entrance is a [[safespot]], which you may wait in until it is safe to mine the nearby rocks.

'''Note''': Mine 1-2 extra if you are planning to complete the easy [[Falador Diary]] and/or want your own [[blurite sword]].
{{Clear}}

===Creating the sword===
{{Needed|2 [[iron bar]]s (4 if making extra sword), [[blurite ore]] (2 if making extra sword)|recommended=an additional [[redberry pie]] if doing [[The Giant Dwarf]]}}
[[File:Blurite sword detail.png|left|80px|frameless]]
Return to [[Thurgo]] with your [[blurite ore]]s and your iron bars and he will make you a sword. If you want a sword for yourself, drop it and ask Thurgo for a replacement, then pick up the second sword again.

'''Note''': [[Members]] planning on doing [[The Giant Dwarf]] soon after this quest are recommended to give Thurgo an additional [[redberry pie]] now to avoid a return trip during that quest.

Go back to the [[Squire]] and he will take one of your blurite swords.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Rewards==
{{Quest rewards
|name = The Knight's Sword
|image = [[File:The Knight's Sword reward scroll.png|centre]]
|qp = 1
|rewards = 
* {{SCP|Smithing|12,725}} [[Smithing]] [[experience]]
*A [[blurite sword]] (if you got [[Thurgo]] to make you an extra one)
*The ability to smelt [[blurite ore]] into [[blurite bar]]s (members only)
}}

==Required for completing==
Completion of The Knight's Sword is required for the following:

* [[Prying Times]]

{{Subject changes

}}
{{Subject changes footer}}

==Trivia==
*When trying to complete the quest while having the [[blurite sword]] equipped, the [[Squire]] would say "So can you un-equip it and hand it over to me now please?"
*The [[Smithing]] experience granted by this quest is so much that, if the player's Smithing level is 1, it will be levelled up to 29 after this quest. If they start at 15 Smithing (to create the iron bars), it will be levelled up to 31.
*This is the only free-to-play quest that requires a skill above level 1.

'''Witch's House''' is a quest involving a [[boy]] whose ball had been lost in the garden of an unpleasant local witch, [[Nora T. Hagg]]. The adventurer is asked to retrieve it, having to figure out how to proceed in [[witch's house (location)|Nora's house]] along the way.

He asks you to get it back for him. This proves more difficult than it first sounds.

==Walkthrough==
{{Map|name=Boy|x=2928|y=3456|r=3|align=left|width=240|height=240|mtype=square|caption=The start point of the quest.}}
===Lost ball===
[[File:Witch's House - Boy.png|thumb|220px|Talking to the [[boy]].]]
Head to [[Taverley]] and talk to the [[boy]] near the eastern entrance along the hedges. He will start crying; ask him what's the matter, and he will say that he kicked his [[ball]] over the hedge into the garden, and the [[Nora T. Hagg|witch]] living in the house put it in her shed. The boy wants you to get it back for him.

===Breaking in===
[[File:Witch's House - Breaking in.png|thumb|220px|The location of the [[Door key (Witch's House)|key]].]]
{{Needed|Cheese, gloves, combat equipment}}
Head west then north around the hedge to the front door of the house - it is locked. Look-under the pot north of the door to find a [[Door key (Witch's House)|door key]] and enter the house. Read the entire [[Diary (Witch's House)|diary]] on the table.

Go down the ladder in the northern room to enter the basement. If you don't already have [[leather gloves]], search the [[boxes (witch's house)|boxes]] for a pair, however it may take many attempts to find them. Equip your gloves, go through the [[gate (witch's house)|gate]], and search the [[cupboard (witch's house)|cupboard]] for the [[Magnet (Witch's House)|magnet]]. Go back up the ladder and into the southern room with the door that leads to the garden. Drop your [[cheese]] or use it on the mouse hole. Suddenly, a [[Mouse (Witch's House)|mouse]] will come out; use the magnet on the mouse and it will unlock the door. '''Be quick or the mouse will leave, and you will lose the cheese.''' Enter the door into the garden.
{{Clear|left}}

[[File:Nora T. Hagg.png|60px|left|frameless]]
===Getting past the witch===
Once in the garden, you will see the [[Nora T. Hagg|witch]] walking back and forth in the middle. You cannot walk through the garden, and must walk around it while using the hedges as cover until you reach the [[fountain (witch's house)|fountain]]. If the witch catches you, she will teleport you out of the garden and you will have to repeat most of the previous steps. Search the fountain to obtain a [[Key (Witch's House)|key]].

{{Clear|left}}
===Witch's experiment===
Head to the shed (east of the courtyard) and use the key on the door. Do '''not''' attempt to take the ball otherwise the [[Witch's experiment]] will lower your stats. Attack the Witch's experiment. Each time you kill the experiment's current form it changes to a stronger form. You have to kill the experiment four times before it is defeated - the first stage is a Skavid (level 19), then a spider (level 30), then a bear (level 42), and finally a wolf (level 53). If you flee during the battle you will have to start over.
[[File:Witch's House - Fighting the Witch's experiment.png|thumb|220px|Fighting the [[Witch's experiment]].]]

:'''Note:''' [[Rings of recoil]] may be used - a maximum of 4 will be required, as the experiments combined have a total of 144 hitpoints.

:'''Note:''' You cannot use a [[Dwarf multicannon]] in the shed.

The first and second forms may be [[safespotted]] with [[Magic]] and [[Ranged]] or [[Flinching|flinched]] with melee by going into the north-east corner and waiting for the experiment to move to the tile south of the player. Once in position, run past it, then walk on top of it. After this, walk west 1 tile until positioned diagonally from the Witch's experiment. It can now be attacked safely.

The third and fourth forms can be more easily safespotted by walking to the south wall of the shed between the sacks and the crate with the [[ball]] on it and using [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] attacks from there.

Once you have killed the Witch's experiment, take the ball and return it to the boy. 

'''Do not let the witch see you''' or she will teleport you outside and '''you will lose the ball'''. You can avoid needing to pass her by teleporting out. If she does catch you, the doors to the shed will need to be unlocked again. Although the creature will respawn, it will not attack you.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===Stolen totem===
[[File:Tribal Totem - Kangai.png|thumb|220px|Kangai in the Shrimp and Parrot shop.]]
[[File:Kangai Mau chathead.png|left]]
Talk to [[Kangai Mau]] in [[Brimhaven]], in the [[the Shrimp and Parrot|Shrimp and Parrot]] food shop. Tell him you are in search of adventure, and he will say that he needs someone to go on a mission to [[Ardougne]]. Lord Handelmort has stolen the [[Rantuki tribe]] tribal totem for his private museum, and he wants you to get it back.
{{Clear|left}}
===Rerouting a magical delivery===
[[File:GPDT employee chathead.png|left|80px|frameless]]
[[File:Tribal Totem - GPDT.png|thumb|220px|right|G.P.D.T.]]
If you were to head to Lord Handelmort's mansion in [[Ardougne]], you would find that the door is locked. You need to find a method to get past the front door.

Instead, head to the [[Gielinor Parcel Delivery Team|GPDT depot]], just west of the [[Ardougne]] docks and just south of the eastern [[bank]]. Investigate the [[crate (Tribal Totem)#Double|north-eastern crate]] to find an [[address label]], addressed to Lord Handelmort. South of this crate is another crate, intended for delivery to the [[Wizards' Tower]]. This crate contains a teleport block, [[Wizard Cromperty]]'s new invention. Use the [[address label]] on this crate to mark it for delivery to the mansion instead.

Ask a nearby [[GPDT employee]] when the crate will be delivered, and he will agree to deliver it now.

===Sneaky teleportation===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Thieving|21}} {{Boostable|yes}} to disable a trap in the following section}}
[[File:Wizard Cromperty chathead.png|left|80px|frameless]]
Talk to [[Wizard Cromperty]], found in the house north-east of the [[Ardougne market]]. '''Do not use the right-click 'Teleport' option,''' or you will be sent to the [[Rune essence mine]]. Ask him what he has invented, and he will tell you about his new teleportation block. Ask to be teleported, then confirm that it sounds good when he says you will end up by the teleportation block. You will find yourself inside Handelmort's mansion.
{{Clear|left}}

===Retrieving the totem===
[[File:Totem detail.png|left|frameless|80px]]
[[File:Tribal Totem - Chest.png|thumb|200px|The chest that contains the Totem.]]
Go west through two doors. The second door is locked; the password is Lord Handelmort's middle name, which is '''K U R T'''. You would have found this out by reading the [[Guide book]] in the Estate Agent's house, after some clues from [[Horacio]] the gardener, but this was not necessary to progress the quest.

Enter the code using the left and right arrows (K=10 right, U=6 left, R=9 left, T=7 left). When the password is set, click enter to unlock the door. 

:'''Note:''' If the password K U R T does not work and it states "This combination is incorrect", try entering the letters very slowly and only clicking the right arrow, as the game may not register the letters if clicking too quickly.

The [[stairs (Tribal Totem)|stairs]] are booby trapped; '''Do not use the "climb-up" option first!''' Instead, '''investigate''' the stairs ({{SCP|Thieving|21}}), then climb up. If {{Mes|You don't find anything interesting}} appears, you don't have the required level.

:'''Note''': If you trigger the trap, you will end up in the [[Ardougne Sewers]]. Go south-west and climb up the ladder, then return to Cromperty for another teleport. You will not need to enter the door code again.

Exit the southern door onto the balcony and enter the room to the east. Open the chest and search it to find the tribal totem.

:'''Note''': You can use the [[drop trick]] if you want more totems as a souvenir.

Return the [[totem]] to Kangai Mau in [[Brimhaven]]. He will give you 5 [[swordfish]] as thanks.

==Walkthrough==
===Protecting the Spirit Tree===
{{Map:Tree Gnome Village path}}
[[File:King Bolren chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Head to the centre of the [[Gnome Maze|Tree Gnome Maze]] (see the map to the right for the path through the maze). The maze is located south-east of [[East Ardougne]] and north of [[Yanille]]. Talk to [[King Bolren]], who will say that three orbs have been stolen by Khazard troops. Agree to help him, and you will be escorted by Elkoy out of the maze.
{{Clear|left}}
===The three trackers===
{{Needed|6 normal logs.}}
[[File:Commander Montai chathead.png|left|frameless]]
{{Map
|align=right
|width=250
|height=250
|x=2511
|y=3250
|mtype=square
|zoom=2
|caption=Tracker gnome locations.
|x:2504,y:3263,r:3,desc:Tracker gnome 1
|x:2524,y:3257,r:3,desc:Tracker gnome 2
|x:2492,y:3231,r:3,desc:Tracker gnome 3
}}

North to the [[Gnome maze|maze]] you will find a [[battlefield]]. Find [[Commander Montai]] and speak with him, he is wearing red clothing. He will ask for you to bring him 6 [[logs]] to repair their defences. After giving him the logs, talk to [[Commander Montai]] again, and he'll tell you that three trackers that have been sent out to retrieve coordinates to fire the [[ballista (Tree Gnome Village)|ballista]] have not returned. He asks you to find them.

You can find all three tracker gnomes at the buildings north to the [[battlefield]]. (look at the picture to the right to see the locations)
{{Clear|left}}
*The first tracker is behind or on the side of the biggest building in the north-west.
*The second tracker is in the north-east building in a Khazard Prison Cell.
*The third tracker is roaming outside the south-west corner of the stronghold.

The first two trackers will give you the coordinates you need, which you'll automatically commit to memory. The third tracker, however, has been driven mad as a result of the chaos. Though most of what he says is garbage, he will give you a hint as to the number you need. You may have to do a bit of guesswork, though. For instance, ''"Less than my hands"'' would equal 1, where ''"More than my head less than my fingers"'' could be 2, ''"More than we but less than our feet"'' is 3, and lastly, ''"My legs and your legs"'' is 4. (It should not be any other possible number so try and remember what the third tracker said.)

Head back to the [[Ballista (Tree Gnome Village)|ballista]] (not the [[Catapult (Battlefield)|catapult]], which is next to Montai), which is located in the south-west corner of the battlefield, here you want to choose the coordinate given from the third gnome tracker. If you miss, just try again until you get it.

===Retrieving the first orb===
{{Needed|recommended=[[Food]] and [[armour]] for low levels}}
[[File:Orb of Protection detail.png|left|80px]]
[[File:Tree Gnome Village - Crumbled wall.png|thumb|250px|The crumbled wall you can climb over.]]
Once you get a hit, talk to [[Commander Montai]] once again then walk north to the stronghold (building where Gnome Tracker 1 was) and climb over the crumbled wall. 

'''Note:''' There is a stall after climbing the crumbled wall where you are attacked without being able to heal; as a low-levelled player, this may be dangerous.

Once you climb the wall you will be attacked by a level 48 [[Khazard commander]]; he has low [[Hitpoints]] (22) and should not be troublesome for most mid-levelled players (can be [[safespot]]ted behind northern broken chair). You can skip defeating the commander if you wish and proceed to the western room and climb up the ladder.

When you climb the [[ladder]] you will once again be attacked by a level 48 [[Khazard commander]], kill him or head to the chest and  find the [[orb of protection]]. When you have the orb, run back down the ladder and out of the nearby door.

Return to the north-west maze entrance and talk to [[Elkoy]], he will offer to lead you through the maze, accept his offer.

Talk to [[King Bolren]] in the centre of the maze and he will inform you that the other two [[orbs of protection]] have been stolen by the [[Khazard warlord|Khazard Warlord]].

===Retrieving the last two orbs===
{{Needed|Combat equipment to defeat a level 112}}
[[File:Khazard warlord chathead.png|left|frameless]]
'''Note:''' The orbs will only be dropped by the Warlord after you've spoken to the King.

{{Map|name=Khazard warlord|2455,3301|r=4|mtype=square|caption=The location of the Khazard warlord.|align=right|width=220|height=220}}

Exit the village and start heading north past the stronghold where you found the first orb. When you hit the wall to [[West Ardougne]], follow it to the west past the wolves and then to the north until you see two [[Khazard trooper|Khazard troopers]] and the level 112  [[Khazard warlord]]. The warlord will be unaggressive until you talk with him, at which point he will challenge you to a fight and attack.

Kill him to retrieve the other two orbs. Players with [[Rune armour]] and at least a [[rune scimitar]] should have little trouble fighting him if they have a small amount of decent quality [[food]] ([[lobster]] or better), though the warlord has a rather large HP of 170.

[[File:Tree Gnome Village - Warlord safespot.png|thumb|left|220px|A player safespotting the Khazard warlord.]]

Lower levelled players may consider using Magic or Ranged to [[safespot]] him. After initiating the fight, head west until the warlord de-aggros near the larger dead tree. Move a little south and attack the warlord with Ranged or Magic while outside his aggro range. This will force the warlord to walk backwards at an angle and get caught against the West Ardougne wall and the northern large dead tree. If done correctly, players can attack the warlord safely as long as they keep distant enough as to not aggro the warlord again. If you fail to get the warlord stuck, you can also simply run away from him whenever he gets close, only attacking him while he is wandering back.

'''Note''': He may despawn if you take too long to kill him using this method.

He may also be [[flinched]] using melee by repeatedly stepping in and out of his walking range. One good spot is beside the large skull to the south. He does not despawn when flinched.

After killing him, pick up the [[orbs of protection]]. Go back to King Bolren and hand over the orbs to him. A cutscene ensues, where the gnomes are seen celebrating and holding a ceremony in which the orbs are returned to their places on the sacred spirit tree.

[[File:Tree Gnome Village - Orbs restored.gif|thumb|left|180px|King Bolren returns the orbs to the spirit tree.]]

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

===Searching for treasure===
{{Needed|recommended=Fast travel to Tree Gnome Village and then a bank for the next section}}
[[File:Almera chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Start out by speaking to [[Almera]] in her house west of the [[Coal Trucks]] and north-east of the [[Baxtorian Falls]] (use the [[games necklace]] to teleport to Barbarian Outpost, and run south). Upstairs in the building, search the southernmost [[bookcase (Waterfall Quest)|bookcase]] on the eastern wall to find a book named [[book on Baxtorian]]. '''Read the book''' or the key will not appear for the next part.

You will discover that [[Lord Baxtorian Cadarn|Baxtorian]] and [[Glarial]] were elven, and read about the legend of treasure under the falls. {{Needed|recommended=[[food]] and [[armour]]}}
[[File:Glarial's pebble detail.png|left|frameless|80px]]
{{Map|x:2533,y:3155|x:2545,y:3155|x:2545,y:3148|x:2542,y:3148|x:2542,y:3150|x:2539,y:3150|x:2539,y:3145|x:2549,y:3145|x:2549,y:3156|x:2551,y:3156|x:2551,y:3159|x:2545,y:3159|x:2545,y:3165|x:2550,y:3165|x:2550,y:3175|x:2544,y:3175|x:2544,y:3177|x:2533,y:3177|x:2533,y:3179|x:2531,y:3179|x:2531,y:3177|x:2529,y:3177|x:2529,y:3179|x:2527,y:3179|x:2527,y:3177|x:2514,y:3177|x:2514,y:3179|x:2521,y:3179|x:2521,y:3184|x:2524,y:3184|x:2524,y:3181|x:2529,y:3181|x:2529,y:3182|x:2532,y:3182|x:2532,y:3188|x:2511,y:3188|x:2511,y:3191|x:2503,y:3191|mtype=line|align=right|height=250|width=250|caption=Follow the line to find the Dungeon.}}

Head to the [[Tree Gnome Village (location)|Tree Gnome Village]] south-west of Ardougne. If you have previously started or completed the [[Tree Gnome Village]] quest, you may follow [[Elkoy]] through the maze, or use the [[Spirit Tree]] from the [[Grand Exchange]] to reach the centre (if it was completed).

'''Note:''' It is recommended to start the Tree Gnome Village quest now by talking to [[King Bolren]] in the centre of the maze, which will allow you to follow [[Elkoy]] through the maze in the future.

If you have not begun [[Tree Gnome Village]] you will have to navigate through the maze. You should find a ladder in the hedge maze. Very low level players should exercise caution due to the [[hobgoblin]]s within. Climb down the ladder, and find [[Key (Gnome Village Dungeon)|the key]] in the east room. The key is in the slightly differently-coloured [[Crate (Tree Gnome Village Dungeon)|crate]] next to the two crates stacked on top of each other in the south-east corner. In the west room, you will find a gnome called [[Golrie]] locked away. Use your key on the door, then speak to the gnome to receive [[Glarial's pebble]].

'''Note:''' You can use the [[drop trick]] to obtain multiple pebbles, which is highly recommended for low level players in case you die during the next steps. You will also save some time in the future by keeping your pebble after the quest if you plan to complete [[Roving Elves]].

Once you've started Tree Gnome Village, you can exit the maze by following [[Elkoy]].

===Tomb Raiding===
{{Needed|[[Glarial's pebble]], two free inventory slots|recommended=Food, a fast travel method to a bank and Baxtorian Falls for the next section}}
[[File:Glarial's tombstone.png|thumb|left|80px|Glarial's tombstone]]
{{Map|name=Glarial's Tombstone|x:2558,y:3445|plane=0|r=4|mapID=0|mtype=square|align=right|height=220|width=220|caption=Glarial's tomb location}}

[[Glarial's Tomb]] has significant restrictions on items you can equip or carry, so it is strongly recommended to bank any prohibited items before travelling to it. Notable restrictions include [[weapons]], [[armour]] (including capes), [[runes]], [[arrows]], and any type of [[Woodcutting#Logs|logs]]. All [[jewellery]] is allowed, so you may choose to bring [[enchanted jewellery]] for transportation (i.e. [[games necklace]] or [[ring of dueling]]) or defence bonuses (i.e. [[amulet of glory]], [[combat bracelet]], or [[steel ring]]). See [[Glarial's Tomb#Restricted items]] for a full list of restricted items. Bring [[food]] with you, as you will need to run past high level monsters.

Head just south-east of [[Baxtorian Falls]] and just north-west of the [[Fishing Guild]] to find a tombstone, and use the pebble on it to enter. Inside, there are high-level monsters that you will need to pass. One strategy is to attack a lower level [[skeleton]] or [[Zombie (common)|zombie]], as the area is single combat and this will prevent  the more dangerous [[Moss Guardian]] attacking you, which has a max hit of 14.

Run to the west part of the cave, past the level 84 moss guardians, and search the chest to get [[Glarial's amulet]]. Then head to the south part of the cave and search the coffin to get [[Glarial's urn]]. '''Note that you will be unable to perform actions while searching the coffin but can be attacked, so beware!'''

'''Note''': You can get multiples of both items using the [[drop trick]], which is advised for low levels as you can die in the next section.


Once you have '''both items''', you can exit the tomb by going up the ladder.

===The Chalice of Eternity===
{{Needed|[[Rope]], 6 [[Air rune]]s, 6 [[water rune]]s, 6 [[earth rune]]s, [[Glarial's urn]], [[Glarial's amulet]], 5 free inventory slots|recommended= [[armour]], [[food]], [[weapon]] if killing a Fire Giant for a diary task, fast travel method out after quest completion}}

Go back to [[Almera]]'s house and board the raft. You will crash again. '''Do not swim or interact with the tree without the rope!''' Use your '''rope''' on the large grey rock on the small patch of land just downstream, then use the '''rope''' on the dead tree that you can climb. When you reach the doors at the waterfall ledge, go inside.

{{Map:Waterfall Dungeon}}
[[File:Waterfall dungeon crate.png|300px|thumb|right|Location of the crate with the key.]]
Take the eastern passage first, running past the level 52 [[Shadow spider]]s, level 45 [[Skeleton]]s and level 16 [[Skeleton Mage]]s to search the '''northernmost''' [[Crate (Waterfall Dungeon)|crate]] for [[A key (Waterfall Dungeon)|a key]].

Once you have the key, take the western passage, then head north past the level 86 [[Fire Giant]]s and pass through the doors until you reach the chalice room. As this is a single combat area, may choose to attack a shadow spider so that the higher levelled giants will be unable to attack you.

'''Tip:''' Killing a Fire Giant here will complete a medium [[Kandarin Diary]] task (not recommended for lower level players).

[[File:Chalice of Eternity.png|100px|thumb|right|The Chalice of Eternity.]]

{{Color|Red|Warning:}} Follow the next part carefully. If done incorrectly you will either be washed from the final room, or take up to 20 damage if you do not place the runes correctly.

Inside the next room, you will find six pillars, two statues, and a [[Chalice of Eternity|chalice]] trophy. Use an [[air rune]], a [[water rune]], and an [[earth rune]] on one pillar, then do the same for the other five. Use Glarial's amulet on the '''Statue of Glarial''', and then use Glarial's urn on the '''Chalice of Eternity''', '''completing the dialogue'''. Take the reward (note that you must have five free slots to accept it) from the chalice after the ground rises up to it to finish! {{Color|Red|Warning:}} any items you drop inside the chamber with the six pillars will be unretrievable once you use Glarial's amulet with the statue. Make sure to drop any items you want to recover outside the chamber by crossing the door.

If you do get flushed out, or leave, the pillars will remain active. However, you will need to retrieve another amulet to re-enter the dungeon.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

He will direct you to talk to [[Glough]], his head tree guardian. ===Charlie the prisoner=== {{Needed|1,000 [[coins]] (if you haven't helped [[Femi]])|recommended=Fast travel to Tree Gnome Stronghold}} {{Map|x=2477|y=3463|r=3|width=220|height=220|mtype=square|align=right|caption=Glough's house location.}} [[File:Glough chathead.png|left|frameless]] Glough is located in a treehouse south of the [[Grand Tree]], east of the ramp by the hot air balloon. After remarking that humans can't be trusted, he will tell you that he will take care of the problem. Return to [[King Narnode Shareen]], who informs you that [[Glough]] has caught and imprisoned a human found with the [[Daconia rock]]s. [[File:The Grand Tree - Talking to Charlie.png|thumb|left|220px|Talking to Charlie.]] Head to the top floor to speak with [[Charlie (prisoner)|Charlie]] the prisoner. He tells you that Glough paid him to retrieve the rocks from Hazelmere. He doesn't know what Glough is up to, but suggests you search Glough's house for evidence. Go to Glough's house and search the [[cupboard (The Grand Tree)|cupboard]] to find his [[Glough's journal|journal]], which describes how he plans to convince the tree gnomes that humans are naturally evil and must be destroyed. Confront Glough, who calls a guard over to lock you in the cell next to Charlie's. Talk to Charlie, who mentions he delivered a large amount of gold to the [[Shipyard (Karamja)|shipyard]] on [[Karamja]]. He suggests you give the foreman there a visit to covertly see if he knows what Glough is up to, and gives you the password to access it, which is '''Ka-Lu-Min'''. [[King Shareen|The king]] will appear and apologise for Glough imprisoning you. He will tell you that guards are watching the entrances, and tells you to quickly escape on the [[Gnome glider]] on the top floor of the [[Grand Tree]], next to the cells. Talk to the pilot. He will ask you where you want to go and you will ask him to fly you to [[Karamja]]. {{Clear|left}} ===Karamja investigation=== [[File:Foreman chathead.png|80px|left|frameless]] The glider will crash land just west of the [[Shipyard (Karamja)|Shipyard]]. Run east, avoiding the [[aggressive]] level 53 [[jogre]]s, and attempt to open the gate to the Shipyard. A [[shipyard worker]] will stop you; tell him Glough sent you, then give him the password '''Ka-Lu-Min'''. Once inside, find the level 23 [[foreman]] on the southern docks. You may either kill him or talk to him to receive a [[lumber order]]. If you choose to talk to him, tell him Glough sent you, then answer some personal questions about Glough. He will ask how his wife is, select "'''Sadly his wife is no longer with us'''". He will then ask what his favourite dish is, select "'''Worm holes'''". Finally, he will ask for his new girlfriend's name, which is "'''Anita'''". {{Chat option|3Sadly his wife is no longer with us!|2He loves worm holes.|1Anita.}} You need to return to the Grand Tree to show the king the lumber order which is evidence of Glough's invasion plans, but Glough has ordered the guards not to let you in. You can now teleport out of the shipyard and head to the Gnome Stronghold, or leave via the charter ship if you brought coins. If you have completed the [[Tree Gnome Village]] quest, you can sneak in by using a [[spirit tree]], such as the one at the [[Grand Exchange]] or the [[Battlefield]]. Alternatively, talk to [[Femi]] by the gate to the stronghold. Tell her you need to get inside, and she will sneak you in. She will help you for free if you never entered the stronghold through the gate before, or if you chose to help her move boxes the first time you entered. If you chose not to help her when you first entered, she will charge you 1,000 coins. ===Tuzo=== {{Needed|[[Lumber order]]|skills={{SCP|Agility|25}} {{Boostable|yes}} to climb the watchtower}} {{Map|x=2391|y=3511|r=3|width=220|height=220|align=left|caption=Anita's house on the map.|mtype=square}} [[File:The Grand Tree - Using the twigs.png|thumb|220px|Using the twigs on the pillars.]] After you show [[King Shareen|the king]] the [[Lumber order|note]] from the [[foreman]], he still will not believe your accusations, call you as paranoid as [[Glough]], and ask you to leave for your own safety. Speak to [[Charlie]] the prisoner again on the top floor of the [[Grand Tree]], who says he heard Glough mention a chest key that he left at his girlfriend [[Anita]]'s house. In the north-west corner of the stronghold, climb up the most north-western ladder by the tortoise pens to speak to [[Anita]] and she will give you [[Glough's key]] and ask you to return it to him. Go to Glough's house, and use the key to open the chest. Inside, you will find his [[invasion plans]] detailing his plan to seize control of [[Gielinor]]. '''Click continue''' to receive the plans. Ensure you have four free inventory spaces, then take the invasion plans to the king. He will still not believe you, stating that anyone could have made the plans. He will give you four bundles of [[twigs]], which was all his guards could find when searching Glough's house. Return to Glough's house, and climb up the watchtower. This tree is located on the east side of the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} by the chest and requires {{SCP|Agility|25}} to climb. Up in the watchtower, you will find a stone stand and four pillars. Use the twigs with the four pillars to spell out ''TUZO'', starting from the far left. Using the [[Translation book]], this translates to "open." After you have placed the twigs on the four pillars, you will hear gears turning, activating the trap door on this platform, '''but do not go in yet unless you are prepared for the fight.''' {{Clear|left}} ===Encountering the Black demon=== {{Needed|[[Combat]] [[equipment]] and [[food]] to last in a fight against a level 172 [[Black demon (The Grand Tree)|Black demon]]}} [[File:Black demon (The Grand Tree, 1) safespot.png|thumb|250px|right|Safespot 1: The recommended safespot located directly north of the entrance ladder.]] Climb down the trapdoor into the cave below, and [[Glough]] will appear, threatening you with his plans to wipe out humans. '''Complete the conversation''' without interacting with anything else, or you will have to re-enter and repeat it. A level 172 [[Black demon (The Grand Tree)|black demon]] will appear down the tunnel and immediately attack you. It can be fought with any combat style, but can be [[safespotted]] with [[Ranged]], [[Magic]] or a [[halberd]]. To safespot, immediately move one tile to the north and then east (adjacent to the ladder, see the picture). [[Magic]] is recommended, as the demon has a negative magic defence bonus. Use [[water spells]] if available to you as it has a 40% [[Elemental weakness|weakness]] to water spells. :'''Note:''' If the demon is not killed within 10 minutes, it will '''disappear''' and the battle needs to be '''restarted'''. To do so, walk through the tunnel and leave through the ladder next to [[King Narnode Shareen]], and re-enter Glough's trapdoor. :'''Note for 10HP pures:''' With [[Bind]], it is possible to kill the demon with a cannon with at least 120 cannonballs. When the scene begins, use Bind on the demon immediately and set up the cannon just 2-3 spaces west of the ladder you used to enter. If you die during setup the cannon will remain. You will know the cannon is in the right area if you can reload it from the ladder safespot. If the cannon aggros a rat during the fight without killing it, the cannon may stop firing, and you will need to take aggro from the demon by moving forward and back, or lure the rat away. ===The adamant king=== [[File:Daconia rock detail.png|left|70px]] After defeating the demon, Glough will flee into the tunnel behind him. Walk along the passage until you find [[King Shareen]] standing by a ladder. Talk to him and tell him that Glough sent a demon to attack you. Not believing you, he will finally send a guard to scout for Glough, finding him hiding amongst the stones. The king apologises, and asks you to locate the last [[Daconia rock]]. Ensure you have one free inventory space, then search the [[Root (The Grand Tree)|roots]] all around the area until you find the Daconia rock. It may be in any of the roots, so keep going until you have found the rock. '''Click continue''' once you find it or it won't appear in your inventory. If you somehow lose the rock, it'll spawn in the root where you first found it. Talk to King Shareen again for your reward for saving the Grand Tree.
