==Walkthrough==
===Troubled Tortugan===
[[File:Elder Raley chathead.png|left]]
{{Bug|You may be unable to start the quest if you have just levelled to the skill requirements, or just completed Troubled Tortugans. Relogging should fix this.}}

Speak to [[Elder Raley]] at his house just south of the bank at [[the Summer Shore]]. He asks whether you've seen [[Floopa]], who has wandered off somewhere. You'll offer to look for her, and Raley recommends that you ask around town whether they've seen her.

{{Map|mtype=pin|3196,2466|caption=Elder Katt, by the Sacred Grove entrance.|align=right|width=200|height=200}}

Speak to any tortugan in the Summer Shore marketplace, and they'll direct you to [[the Sacred Grove]] to the north-east. Speak to [[Elder Katt]], who will permit you temporary access to the Grove. Upon entering the Grove, speak to [[Floopa]] to the north-west, who will tell you that she was just out to gather camphor logs, but is taking a while due to her injury.

She further says that the camphor wood is for a new spear, and upon pressing her for details, she reveals that she recognized the ship that sailed away from [[the Little Pearl]] during the events of [[Troubled Tortugans]], which is a ship owned by the [[Red Reef Trading Company]]. Once a navigator for their flagship, [[The Zenith]], she was betrayed by [[Spencer Brentwood]], the company's founder, who caused the events that resulted in her injury.

You will offer to investigate the trading company on her behalf while she recovers, and she tells you that their headquarters is on [[Red Rock]], to the far west of [[the Great Conch]].

===Problem Solving===
[[File:Display (The Red Reef).png|x160px|left]]
Make your way to [[Red Rock]] via [[boat]]. 

:'''Tip:''' While in Red Rock, inspect the [[Sailors' Marker]] next to [[Shipwright Sylvia]] to unlock the teleport for the [[sailor's amulet]].

Head to the building headquarters to the west and speak to the [[receptionist]], who will set you up with a meeting with her superior, [[Theodore Paxton]], after hearing of your need for employment. She will tell you to inspect the [[Display (The Red Reef)|displays]] detailing the company's history while you wait. Start with the display closest to the door, and move anti-clockwise to view the displays in chronological order. Once all four displays have been inspected, players will be able to speak to Theodore Paxton in the southern part of the building.

Theodore will ask that you help deal with a pirate captain named [[Black Eye Bethel]], who has been attacking the company's ships. He will ask that you sail to their hideout at [[Last Light]] and "put an end to her and her ships".
{{Clear}}
===Last Light===
{{Needed|recommended=Repair kits, cannonballs for ship combat, and combat equipment to subsequently defeat six pirates and Black Eye Bethel. [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] is recommended if skipping ship combat}}
{{Instance}}
Sail south towards Last Light, and the ''The Bark of the Bight'' and ''The Four of a Kind'' will appear upon approaching the island, immediately attacking the player and player's boat when in range.
[[File:The Red Reef - pirate ships.png|thumb|300px|Pirates aboard ''The Bark of the Bight'' and ''The Four of a Kind'' attack the player's boat.]]

Each boat has 250 hitpoints and 4 crew members: one captain, one helmsman, and two cannoneers.
* [[Captain Jack]]/[[Captain Ruban Acer]]: Will directly attack the player with ranged attacks; [[Protect from Missiles]] blocks all damage. If their helmsman is killed, they will take over the steering of the ship.
* [[Bloody Jack]]/[[Mister U.]]: Mans the helm of the ship.
* [[Old Jack]]/[[Mute Jack]]/[[Oaky Doak]]/[[Boatswain Bill Teak]]: Mans one of the cannons each; each cannon has a 180 degree range of fire. If all other crewmates are killed, they will attack the player with ranged attacks.

To defeat both ships, players must either kill all of the crew onboard or sink the ship; the former requires magic or ranged attacks, while the latter requires the use of [[Cannon (facility)|cannons]] on the player's boat. It is recommended to only pursue one of the two methods. Players with lower stats and/or cannon tiers should bring at least 300 hitpoints in [[repair kits]], preferably teak or higher.
* For the cannon method, players should be using a sloop with both cannons on the same side of the boat. One of the cannons should be manned by the player themselves, as this greatly increases the cannon's accuracy and damage. Wear equipment with good ranged bonuses as these affect the cannon's damage output. Be aware that [[crewmate]]s must have a sufficiently high [[Privateering]] stat to operate higher tier cannons. Players may be tempted to reclick after performing actions such as drinking a potion, but clicking the cannon again will disengage the player from it, while reclicking the boat runs the risk of accidentally clicking a pirate, which causes the player to stop firing. 
* Players with strong weapons and combat stats can opt to kill the pirate crew instead; each boat's crew has a total of 450 hitpoints. Players can target the captains (or helmsmen, as the captains will take over their jobs) first to reduce the need for protection prayers, or they can prioritise the cannoneers to reduce the need for repair kits.

Once both ships are dealt with, sail further south to [[Last Light]]. Upon disembarking, players must defeat six [[Pirate (The Red Reef)|pirates]] in multi-combat before they can head upstairs. The four pirates outside may be [[safespotted]] by trapping them to the north of the mooring point, while the two pirates inside may be [[flinched]] by standing just north of the staircase. [[Protect from Melee]] will prevent all damage. Leaving the fight early via the mooring point will reset the fight.

:{{Color|red|Warning:}} Teleporting away from the island after docking will cause your ship to become lost at sea, along with its contents.

==== Black Eye Bethel ====
[[File:Black Eye Bethel chathead.png|left|80px]]
Head up two flights of stairs to find [[Black Eye Bethel]]. She will only attack with melee, but has various special mechanics:
* Step out of the way when she charges up an attack. Her attack will still hit you even if you're several tiles back; instead you must stand to the left or right of the row of tiles she's facing. You'll know she's charging up when the tile she stands on turns blue, and she says {{Overhead|Dodge this!}}.
* Upon reaching below 70% health, she will switch to a rune scimitar, which increases her max hit but decreases her accuracy and defence.
* Upon reaching below 40% health, she will switch to a dragon scimitar, which increases her max hit further but decreases her accuracy and defence further. Additionally, she can use its special attack to disable the player's protection prayer.

If you die to Black Eye Bethel, you will not be required to fight the six pirates on the Last Light again.

Upon defeating Black Eye Bethel, return to Theodore Paxton at Red Rock, who will refer you to his boss [[Spencer Brentwood]].

=== Meeting the Boss ===
[[File:The Zenith.png|thumb|250px|Spencer Brentwood's ship, ''The Zenith''.]]
[[File:Spencer Brentwood (Diving).png|80px|left]]
Sail to ''The Zenith,'' found to the east of Red Rock.

{{Bug|The Zenith is missing on most worlds. It should be where the map says "Red Reef." If it's not there, hop worlds until you find it.}}
[[File:The Red Reef - seabed.png|thumb|300px|The seabed in the Red Reef.]]
Speak to Spencer Brentwood upon boarding ''The Zenith'', and he'll ask that you come along to help him repair the [[coral dredger]]s on the seabed. If you did not bring diving equipment, he will provide you with a set. Note that even with [[flippers]] you will not be able to run in this section. Should you need to leave, speak to Spencer to board your boat again; teleporting out will result in the boat being '''lost at sea''' and must be recovered via shipwright!

Once you reach the seabed, talk to Spencer about repairing the dredgers. After talking to him, the option to repair will be visible and you can help Spencer repair the northern coral dredger. Upon attempting to do so, a [[Giant lobster (The Red Reef)|giant lobster]] will appear. It can be safespotted by standing to the west of the dredger, moving down to attack and then back up to prevent the lobster from pathing towards you. It may use a special attack which can be avoided by moving when bluish particles appear under you. You may also choose to avoid the fight altogether by waiting for it to despawn.
[[File:The Red Reef - Giant lobster safespot.png|thumb|A safespot for the giant lobster fight.]]

Upon defeating the giant lobster, repair the coral dredger and head to the dredger to the south-east to find Spencer, who will take your back to the surface. He will at last reveal to you the issue he faces: the red coral in the [[Red Reef]] is depleting, and he requires a new source of red coral - a large reef in the [[Pearl Bank]]. However, as [[the Little Pearl]] is nearby, the tortugans will not allow the company to set up operations, confirming their involvement in the attack on the island. He will task you with finding a way for the company to acquire the Little Pearl with minimal bloodshed.

Return to [[Elder Raley]]'s house, where you will find that [[Floopa]] has returned as well. Report your findings to them, and they will reward you with access to [[The Sacred Grove]] and a [[Bosun's workbench schematic|schematic]].

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Trivia==
* From [[14 January]] to [[21 January]] [[2026]], the quest was listed in the modern skill guide interface for Sailing under the "Quest XP" tab, with the text in grey ({{colour|#9f9f9f|The Red Reef}}). When the quest was clicked on, the usual interface opened but with the description:
{{Cquote2|{{colour|#000080|This quest is coming soon...}}

{{colour|#000080|When it releases, I can start it by talking to}} {{colour|#800000|Raley}} {{colour|#000080|at his home on the}} {{colour|#800000|Great Conch}}{{colour|#000080|.}}}}

* One of the display cases in the Red Reef's company offices states that [[Spencer Brentwood]] was given a "small loan of one million gold" from his father to start the Brentwood Trading Company. This is a reference to a well-known quote by US President Donald Trump about receiving a "small loan of a million dollars" from his father.
* The captain of one of the pirate ships fought during the quest is named "Captain Jack," which is likely a reference to {{Wp|Jack Sparrow|Captain Jack Sparrow}} from the {{Wp|Pirates of the Carribbean}} franchise.
* When Black Eye Bethel switches to her dragon scimitar, she will shout {{overhead|I stole this one from a monkey!}}, which is a reference to how [[Monkey Madness I]] is required to wield the scimitar.
** If the player is wielding their own dragon scimitar when Bethel is switching to hers, she will instead shout {{overhead|Nice scimitar! I've got one too!}}.
* There is a [[Parrot (Last Light)|red parrot]] in a cage on the upper floor of the [[Last Light]] lighthouse which can be released, this is not required during the quest.
* The red coral that Brentwood's company harvests is used by mages for "divination," dreams of the future. He also tells the player about his own dream, pertaining to: "The future of humanity, of course. I've long believed our salvation lies beneath the waves. Indeed, I myself feel far more alive below the sea than above it. I'd be very keen to show you." These themes (dreams of the future and salvation beneath the waves willingly shared) have a significant resemblance with the powers of [[Xau-Tak|an influential deity]], and especially what is known of {{RSL|Xau-Tak|the same deity}} in ''RuneScape 3''.

==Walkthrough==
Talk to [[Ranulph]] in north-western [[Auburnvale]]. Ask him what he's preoccupied by, and he will tell you about the strange behaviour of the local ents. Together you will investigate a totem, which Ranulph will break. [[Isadora]], a nearby child, will see this happen and tell you that you now need to build a new totem.

Ranulph and Isadora will tell you to take a set of logs, oak or better, and use them to build the base of the new totem. 

* Click on the [[totem site]] to the north to build the totem base, then return to Ranulph and Isadora. Various trees are scattered around the totem that can be chopped for logs. 
* Next they will tell you to carve depictions of the nearby spirit into the totem. Click on the totem, then click on the options for each of the nearby spirit animals. The animals are unique for each player. 
* After this, return to Ranulph and Isadora. They will tell you to decorate the tree using bows or shields fletched from the same material as the totem. With four of these items in your inventory, click on the totem to decorate it. 
* At this point Ranulph and Isadora will tell you that the ents approve of the totem and left an offering for you. Click on the offerings to claim them. After this, speak to Ranulph or Isadora to receive [[Sacraments of Ent Folk]] and complete the miniquest.

==Walkthrough==
=== The cash cow===
[[File:Cassius chathead.png|left]]
Speak with [[Cassius]] by the Lumbridge pond, just south of the [[Lumbridge windmill|windmill]]. He will offer you a partnership in his future milk empire, and ask you to question [[Seth Groats|Seth]] and [[Gillie Groats]] about how they've made their animals so productive.

[[Gillie Groats]] can be found inside the [[Lumbridge cow field]], just north of the gate. Talk to her and she'll say that happiness is the secret to better milk production, and suggest you talk to her father.

[[Seth Groats]] can be found inside the house by the chicken coop, slightly north-west of the cow field. He will recommend his book, [[Groats Principles|The Groats Principles]], which discusses his approach to husbandry. Search the [[shelves (The Ides of Milk)|shelves]] on the southern wall to obtain it, and return to Cassius.
[[File:Brutus and cow.png|thumb|width=400x400|The massive bull in the cow pen.]]
Cassius will snatch the book away, and offer a [[milk sample]]. Drink the sample to discover that his milk tastes awful. Although the player takes 1 poison damage, they will '''not''' be poisoned and cannot die. Speak to him again, and he will give you another milk sample for [[Duke Horacio]] to try, in order to convince the Duke to give you a permit for selling the milk.{{Clear|left}}

===A milketoast product===
[[File:Duke Horacio chathead.png|left]]
[[Duke Horacio]] can be found in [[Lumbridge Castle]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}. Ask about the permit, and he'll refuse to issue it without the Groats' approval, seemingly worried about their potential response. He will ask you to speak with Gillie directly.

Return to Gillie and offer her the sample. She'll be apprehensive about drinking a strange liquid, and ask you to drink the sample instead. Drink it (no damage will be dealt this time) to find that it tastes even worse than the first one. Gillie will comment that she might be helping people out by refusing to give a permit, given how bad the milk seems to be. You will then ask if there's anything you can do to convince her to give you one, and she'll mention that an aggressive bull has been disrupting her herd, saying that if you deal with it, she'll authorize the permit. Head to the gate north east of her and prepare for a fight.
{{Clear|left}}

=== Grabbing the bull by its horns===
{{Instance}}
{{see also|Bull/Strategies}}
Upon entering the north-eastern gate you will need to fight the [[Brutus|bull]]. If you wish to leave during the fight, run south-west to the gate to escape.

The bull attacks using melee with a max hit of 3. However, this cannot kill the player during the quest, as they will always hit for 0 if the player is at 1 [[Hitpoint]]. After three melee attacks, he will also start using his special attacks after 1-6 hits. The damage of both special attacks scale with the player's [[Hitpoints]] level, with a max hit of upwards of 19. This damage is '''NOT''' mitigated like his auto-attacks, and will kill the player if they hit. Low level players can expect to be hit for around 30-40% of their health by the special attacks. This damage ignores protection prayers, but may be avoided entirely by moving out of the way before Brutus moves.

* When the bull {{overhead|*snorts*}}, he will then slam the ground and hit a number of tiles around the player, either a 3x1 row (if the player is adjacent to him) or an L shape (if the player is diagonal to him). This attack can be fully avoided by stepping two tiles '''to either side''' or one tile '''backwards'''.
* When the bull {{overhead|*growls*}}, he is about to charge towards the player. This attack can be fully avoided by stepping two tiles '''to either side'''.

:'''Note:''' For [[combat pures]], [[Rings of recoil]] may be used to avoid gaining [[Hitpoints]] experience.

After defeating the bull, your player will pick up the tag he drops and it reveals the bull was Brutus, Cassius' supposed business associate. Return to Gillie and let her know that the bull belonged to Cassius. She'll tell you to confront him; return to Cassius, and it is revealed that he was stealing milk from Seth's cow herd, and Brutus' aggression disrupting the herd was causing them to produce bad milk. He then chastises you for killing Brutus, and refuses to speak to you further.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

''After completing the quest, return to Gillie to receive the additional quest rewards.''

=== Getting Started ===
Talk to Betty outside of the north-easternmost house in Land's End. She will inform the player that her father has been murdered. Speak with Sergeant Hudson to get permission to help solve the case. He will reluctantly allow the player to search around the house for clues.
=== Land's End ===
Upon inspection of each part of the body laying on the bed, the player will find the victim's eyes looking towards the wall by the door, hands missing, and a single stab wound to the torso. Inspecting the torso also reveals a letter containing a coded message. The decoded text, after acquiring all the letters, will list descriptions of the murder targets in the quest:

{{Blockquote|THE RECIPE FOR A BETTER ?ORLD{{sic|W is encoded incorrectly}}

HANDS OF THE ABUSER MADE SALTY BY THE DOCKS

TONGUE OF A MAN WITH A GREEN THUMBED LIFE

FEET FROM A WOMAN WHO MARCHED TO THE PORT

EYES OF A LEADER BLINDED BY THE TOIL OF WAR

FINALLY THE HEART OF ONE SO FOOLISH THEY NEVER STOPPED TO ASK WHY}}

Search the shelves next to the door for a newspaper cutting describing a murderer called, "The Cutter."

Search the blood on the wall north of the door for part of the key for letters "H," "I," "D," and "E."

Speak to [[Lan the Butcher]] who informs the player that the victim used Land's End as his "holiday home," and that he was "some big important somebody up in Shayzien once." Search the bed in his house to find a bloody knife. Upon showing the knife to Lan, he will say it's bloody from the meat and he's been looking for it for a while.

Speak to [[Hugor]] who informs the player that the victim's name is Jack Holland, and that he lived in Land's End for a long time with his daughter. He claims he heard shouting around the time of the incident 

Go back and speak to Betty, who will tell the player that her mother and sister were also murdered in Land's End, possibly due to Jack's time as a judge.

After speaking with everyone in Land's End, speak to Sergeant Hudson again. Sergeant Hudson will ask Betty if she has somewhere to stay temporarily, to which she responds she can stay in her uncle's house south of Hosidius. Betty expresses distrust for the Shayzien Constabulary and fear for her life, but ultimately agrees to stay in Hosidius for now.

=== Hosidius ===
{{map|mtype=polygon|width=250|height=250|1790,3521|1790,3527|1784,3527|1784,3521|caption=Betty's uncle's house, north west of [[Tithe Farm]].|align=right}}
Head to the house northwest of the Tithe Farm to speak more with Betty. After she tells you the door is locked, climb through the open window on the western side of the house and open the door to let her inside.

Betty will head down into the basement and scream, prompting the player to follow her down. Upon entering, the player will find another dead body, this time headless. 

Upon further inspection, the player will find a single stab wound to the torso, the victim's shoes covered in dirt, and a half-full wine bottle full of separated liquid next to the body. Searching the shelves on the north wall reveals two empty spaces where bottles should be. Speak to Betty and ask if her uncle was a drinker. She will reveal that he liked to drink alone. 

Go back upstairs and search the bookshelf on the west wall to find Bernard Holland's certificate of membership for the Keystone Lodge. Then, go outside and search the compost bin just north of the house to find a decapitated head. Inspect the head to find a letter in place of the tongue. The letter contains the key for letters "Y," "O," "U," and "R."

Speak to Joyce in the potato field west of the house, who will tell you the house belongs to Bernard Holland, a farming hobbyist from Shayzien. Then, speak to the monk just to the south, who will call the owner of the house a "blaspheming dissident," and claimed that he threatened violence if the monk didn't stop proselytizing.

After speaking to Joyce and the monk, return to Betty in the basement and ask about the Keystone Lodge. She will reveal that her uncle and father were both members of the group, and that it closed down a few months ago due to a lack of new members.

After exhausting all of Betty's dialog options, the player can share everything they've found. After the conversation, Betty will offer the player transport to Port Piscarilius.

=== Piscarilius ===
{{map|mtype=polygon|width=250|height=250|1759,3774|1759,3784|1753,3784|1753,3774|caption=House of Captain Jensen, north west corner [[Port Piscarilius]].|align=right}}
Upon arriving in Port Piscarilius, Sergeant Hudson will immediately arrest the player and Betty, treating them like murder suspects. Once in the prison cell, remove the plank from the north wall of the cell and climb through the gap. 

Head to the north-westernmost house in Port Piscarilius, and sneak past the two stationary guards on the first floor. Climb the ladder to the second floor and inspect the dead body in the room. The player finds that the victim has a bruise on her forehead, a broken nose, a single stab wound to the torso, and missing feet. Search the drawers in the room to find a black dagger, and inspect the blood on top to uncover the key for letters "S," "I," and "N."

Climb up the ladder to the top floor and inspect the bed to find a carving that matches the tagline one on the certificate of membership. Search the wardrobe to discover an old pair of Shayzien boots.

Return to the jail (getting caught is easiest) and inspect the blood on the east wall to find the message, "Another one down. Will you save her in time?" along with the key for letters "B," "E," "T," and "Y."

=== Shayzien ===
Go to the [[War Tent]] in the [[Shayzien Encampment]], where the player will be stopped by Sergeant Hudson just before entering. After a brief argument, Corporal Breiman will appear with news that the killer struck again, this time with witnesses reporting a hooded figure leaving the scene. Corporal Breiman names the new victim to be the former Commissioner before leaving with Sergeant Hudson to investigate.

Run to the house just to the north of where the cutscene drops the player off. Upon inspecting the body, the player discovers the victim's eyes missing, a cut on one of their hands, and a single stab wound to the torso. Searching the shelves reveals a wine bottle with an inscription matching the one on the certificate of membership and the wooden bedframe. Inspecting the blood on the wall reveals the message, "X marks the spot."

Interrogate Kyle, on the path just south of the house, who says he saw a slender-built person in a hood running away from the house at the time of the murder. He also mentions that the recent victim was someone who put criminals away or killed them.

Speak to Sergeant Hudson. '''The quest log will suggest revisiting all the previous murder sites but that is unnecessary.''' Using the clue "X marks the spot" paired with suggestion to revisit the previous murder locations, players can draw a crosshair centered on the island west of Watson's house.
{{map|zoom=2|x=1615|y=3582|group=alone|width=250|height=250|caption=Inspect plant between two trees on the island, west of [[Watson's house]].</br>Grey lines drawn between murder scenes, marking the location.|align=right
|mtype:pin,1615:3582
|mtype:line,1516:3440,1756:3779,stroke:#AEAEAE,stroke-width:2
|mtype:line,1787:3523,1451:3642,stroke:#AEAEAE,stroke-width:2
}}

=== Watson's House ===
Cross the bridge to the island west of [[Watson's house|Watson's House]], just south of [[Kourend Castle]]. Inspect the plant between the two trees to find a trapdoor underneath. Climb down and inspect the blood on the east wall to find the message, "Welcome home." Reading the message triggers a cutscene in which a hooded figure enters the room to knock the player out. When the player comes to, the murderer reveals themselves and their motives.
